title: Professional summary
intro: Senior Software Engineer - Frontend with 6 years building production React.js and Next.js applications across automotive, healthcare, entertainment, and government platforms. Focused on Core Web Vitals optimization, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, and frontend security. Experienced mentoring engineers, working in Agile/Scrum teams with Jira, and establishing code quality standards.

body: Day to day that means designing component libraries and state/data-fetching patterns teams can build on, testing the flows that carry money and personal data, and owning code quality standards within Agile/Scrum delivery. I most recently mentored four engineers at Appinventiv, where the React, TypeScript and accessibility review standards I established were adopted team-wide.
